 th
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.P.P and learned counsel for the informant.

2. The applicant-husband, who is in custody since 12.02.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Mango P.S. Case No.28 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 120B/ 312/ 313/ 377/ 494/ 498A/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.

Learned counsel for both the parties have jointly submitted that the matter may be referred to the Member Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi, for settlement of the dispute between the parties as there is a matrimonial dispute between the parties.

sentences.text: Considering the above submission of the learned counsel for both the parties, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on provisional bail for a period of three months from the date of release.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on provisional bail, on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Jamshedpur, in connection with Mango P.S. Case No.28 of 2023, on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

5. In order to settle the dispute between the parties, the matter is referred to the Member Secretary,
JHALSA, Ranchi.

The applicant-husband and the O.P. No.02/wife, are directed to appear before the Member Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi on 21.06.2023 at 11:00 A.M and the Member Secretary,
JHALSA, Ranchi is directed to conciliate the matter and submit a report in this regard before this Court within two months.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
